headline: Dead Lands, Fishermans Row See Fresh Base Swaps
war_summary: Since the 1805 edition the front has tightened to a handful of volatile sectors. Dead Lands remains the bloodiest theatre, logging five ownership flips in the last six hours and eighteen over the past day while combined casualties still exceed 2,800 per hour. Fishermans Row surged anew, recording five captures in the most recent two‑hour window, six in six hours and twenty in twenty‑four, keeping it the most fluid hex. Godcrofts added a single flip in the last two hours and eight in six, and Farranac Coast posted three captures in the same six‑hour span. Lykos Isle and Linn Mercy each produced a half‑dozen daily changes though neither showed movement in the latest six hours. Meanwhile the massive attrition zones — Weathered Expanse, Callahans Passage, Kings Cage, Marban Hollow, Loch Mor, Stlican Shelf and Stonecradle — continue to bleed manpower with casualty rates climbing or holding steady, yet without territorial movement. Base turnover is now concentrated in Dead Lands, Fishermans Row, Godcrofts, Farranac Coast, Lykos Isle and Linn Mercy, while the broader front remains locked in high‑casualty grinding.
